text:
Type: large black wall clock
Use: telling time at a glance on a wall; kitchen, living room, home office, dining room
Style: classic, traditional, retro
Materials: glossy black case, chrome-look inner ring, white dial behind glass
Colors: black, white, silver
Shape: round face with a thick rolled bezel, bold black serif numerals and minute ticks, black hands, station-clock look, large and graphic
Feel: classic, practical, bold
Goes with: white walls, black accents, steel and wood; classic kitchens, industrial or farmhouse rooms
